opportunities.name: Resy: find a city's restaurant or event and open its reservation or ticket flow
opportunities.description: Switch Resy to a given city, search for a restaurant by name or open a Special Events listing, pick an event, choose a party or ticket count, and open the booking or reservation screen.
steps: Open the Resy home page and, if needed, click the city selector in the header.
Choose the target city from the Popular Cities list (or type it).
Either type a restaurant name into 'Search restaurants, cuisines, etc.' and pick the suggestion, or click 'View all <city> Restaurants'.
Open the Special Events & Experiences section (or the event card) and click the target event.
On the event page, open the ticket or party-size dropdown and select the number of tickets.
Click 'Book Now' or the time-slot button for the desired session.
Read the 'Complete Your Reservation' or order summary panel and stop before any payment step.
parameters: restaurant or event name (Carbone Beach, Happy Hour Burger, Tsiakkos & Charcoal)

instances.values: City Austin changed to Miami; 'View all Miami Restaurants'; event 'Thursday, May 4th | American Express Presents CARBONE BEACH 2023'; 2 then 3 Centurion Member tickets; order summary shown ($9,810).
City Atlanta Special Events; event 'Aria HAPPY HOUR BURGER' (Apr 13); 1 ticket; 5:00 PM slot; 'Complete Your Reservation' modal opened.
City Columbus, OH; typed 'Tsiakkos & Charcoal' in the header search and chose the suggestion; restaurant page opened for 2 guests, today (no availability shown).

opportunities.name: NPS: list national parks for a chosen state from the Find a Park dropdown
opportunities.description: On the National Park Service home page, choose a state from the 'By State...' dropdown and open the resulting parks, heritage areas, or trails list for that state.
steps: Open the National Park Service home page.
Click the 'By State...' dropdown under 'Find a Park'.
Scroll the list and click the target state.
Wait for the state's park listing page to load and review the results (park names, alerts, maps).

instances.values: State = Alaska; results show Alaska parks (Alagnak, Alaska Public Lands, Aleutian Islands WWII) and the heritage-area map.
State = Florida (inferred from results: De Soto, Dry Tortugas, Everglades listed); dropdown list scrolled before selection.
State = California; results show California National Historic Trail, Castle Mountains, César E. Chávez.

opportunities.name: Megabus: track a bus by service number
opportunities.description: On the Megabus site, open 'Check my bus', switch to the Service Number tab, enter a service code, and click 'Find my bus' to view live tracking.
steps: Open the Megabus home page and click 'Check my bus' in the top navigation.
On the 'Track your Bus' page, click the 'Service Number' tab.
Click the 'Search by Service Number' field and type the service code.
Pick the suggested service from the autocomplete list if it appears.
Click 'Find my bus' and read the live departure and arrival times.

instances.values: Navigated to Check my bus, opened the Service Number tab; no code entered in the captured frames.
Logged-in session; opened the Check my bus menu only (partial occurrence, no code entered).
Service code 'SE4' typed, autocomplete suggestion shown, 'Find my bus' clicked.
